model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for different fine-tuned models, comparing their performance across various medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and has a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22, with tick labels at every integer value. Each category on the horizontal axis is associated with a group of six bars, representing the Mistralv0.2-Base model and its fine-tuned versions on different specialties, as indicated by the legend: Cardio (light orange), Gastro (peach), Infect (orange), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (dark brown), and Pediatrics (darkest brown). The bars are grouped by per-specialty terms, with each group containing the same set of fine-tuned models in the same order. The bar heights vary across the groups, with the Cardio group having the tallest bar at around -22.5 for the Cardio fine-tuned model and the shortest bar at around -26.5 for the Mistralv0.2-Base model. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order, but the overall pattern shows that the fine-tuned models generally have higher negative log probabilities than the base model. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on particular bars.
